subject: pe
title: Outdoor Activities: Climbing
welcome_lead: From indoor walls to outdoor crags — climbing is challenge and trust.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: climbing basics, holds, belay, safety.
final_note: Climb with care, communication and the right rope work.

concepts.def: Going up rock, walls or trees safely.
Belt and leg loops for the rope.
Controlling the rope to keep climber safe.
Metal clip linking rope and gear.
Climbing low without ropes on mats.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use feet first. Holds can be edges, slopers and pockets. Keep arms straight when you can to save energy.
The harness ties the climber to the rope. A trained belay partner takes up slack and catches falls.
Standard calls: 'On belay?', 'Climbing!', 'Take!'. Loud and clear keeps everyone safe.
